812: 		} else {
813: 			if (bfd.obtainVia.isStatic()) {
814: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
815: 					JCExpression typeRef = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
816: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(typeRef, job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
817: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME))));

827: 		JCExpression arg;
